description.it: Risultati del club scelto in tutte le partite importate.
description.en: The chosen club's results in every imported match.

title.it: Vittorie, pareggi e sconfitte per stagione
title.en: Wins, draws and losses by season

widgets.sql: SELECT season_start_year AS season, sum(gf > ga) AS won, sum(gf = ga) AS drawn, sum(gf < ga) AS lost FROM (SELECT season_start_year, CASE WHEN home_club_uid = :club THEN home_goals ELSE away_goals END AS gf, CASE WHEN home_club_uid = :club THEN away_goals ELSE home_goals END AS ga FROM fixtures WHERE played = 1 AND home_goals IS NOT NULL AND season_start_year IS NOT NULL AND (home_club_uid = :club OR away_club_uid = :club)) GROUP BY season_start_year ORDER BY season_start_year

title.it: Gol fatti e subiti per stagione
title.en: Goals scored and conceded by season

widgets.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT season_start_year AS season, CASE WHEN home_club_uid = :club THEN home_goals ELSE away_goals END AS gf, CASE WHEN home_club_uid = :club THEN away_goals ELSE home_goals END AS ga FROM fixtures WHERE played = 1 AND home_goals IS NOT NULL AND season_start_year IS NOT NULL AND (home_club_uid = :club OR away_club_uid = :club)) SELECT season, 'scored' AS series, sum(gf) AS value FROM m GROUP BY season UNION ALL SELECT season, 'conceded', sum(ga) FROM m GROUP BY season ORDER BY season

SELECT f.date, coalesce(c.name, 'Competition ' || coalesce(c.database_id, f.competition_id)) AS competition, f.home_club_name, f.home_goals, f.away_goals, f.away_club_name FROM fixtures f LEFT JOIN competitions c ON c.id = f.competition_id WHERE f.played = 1 AND (f.home_club_uid = :club OR f.away_club_uid = :club) ORDER BY f.date DESC LIMIT 200
